read_file.desc: Read file contents. Text files returned as UTF-8; files with NUL bytes or invalid UTF-8 are returned base64-encoded with a header indicating so. For large files, use head/tail or start_line/end_line to read only what you need — call get_file_info first to learn the line count. Precedence when multiple narrowing params are set: ranges > head/tail > start_line/end_line.

params.max_bytes: Maximum bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Raise only when you truly need more context.
params.head: Return only the first N lines.
params.tail: Return only the last N lines.
params.show_line_numbers: Prefix every line with its line number. Default: false.
params.ranges: Array of [start_line, end_line] pairs for multiple non-contiguous ranges in one call (e.g. [[1,10],[50,60]]). Supersedes start_line/end_line.

write_file.desc: Write content to a file, creating or overwriting it. Creates parent directories automatically. Returns a unified diff when overwriting an existing file. For modifying specific sections, prefer edit_file — it is surgical and less error-prone than rewriting the entire file.

params.create_dirs: Create missing parent directories. Default: true.
params.show_diff: Return a unified diff of changes when overwriting. Default: true for existing files, false for new files.
params.max_diff_bytes: Maximum diff bytes to return when show_diff is enabled. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Set 0 for unlimited.

append_to_file.desc: Append content to a file, creating the file and any missing parent directories if needed. Returns the new file size.

edit_file.desc: Surgical find-and-replace in a file. Prefer this over write_file for modifying existing files — sends only the diff, not the entire content. Two modes: single edit (old_str + new_str) or batch edits array — use batch for multiple changes to the same file to avoid repeated round-trips. If old_str appears multiple times, only the first match is replaced (use replace_all=true or add more surrounding context to disambiguate). If pattern is not found, a near-miss probe shows surrounding context to help you refine. Supports Go regex with $1/$2 back-references. Handles CRLF transparently.

params.old_str: Text (or regex) to find — single-edit mode.
params.use_regex: Treat old_str as a Go regular expression. Default: false.
params.replace_all: Replace every match, not just the first. Default: false.
params.dry_run: Preview changes without writing. Default: false.
params.context_lines: Context lines shown around each change in the diff. Default: 3.
params.max_diff_bytes: Maximum diff bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Set 0 for unlimited.
params.edits: Batch mode: array of {old_str, new_str, use_regex?, replace_all?} edits applied sequentially.

delete_file.desc: Delete a single file. IRREVERSIBLE. For directories, use delete_directory instead.

copy_file.desc: Copy a single file (not directories). Creates parent directories of the destination automatically. To duplicate a directory tree, use compress_files + extract_archive, or call copy_file per-file.

params.overwrite: Overwrite if destination exists. Default: false.

move_file.desc: Move or rename a file or directory. Cross-device safe (copy + delete). IRREVERSIBLE if destination already exists and overwrite=true.

params.overwrite: Overwrite if destination exists. Default: false.

get_file_info.desc: Return metadata for a file or directory: type, size, modification time, permissions, symlink target, and line count for text files. Check line count here before using start_line/end_line in read_file.

params.path: Path to the file or directory.

path_exists.desc: Lightweight check: does this path exist and what is its type (file/directory/symlink)? Also returns size. Faster than read_file or get_file_info when you only need to confirm existence — use this to branch before read/write operations.

diff_files.desc: Compare two files and return a unified diff. Returns empty output when files are identical. Cross-platform — prefer this over running diff via run_command.

params.context_lines: Context lines around each change. Default: 3.
params.max_file_bytes: Maximum size for each input file before refusing to diff. Default: 2097152 (2 MB). Set 0 for unlimited.
params.max_diff_bytes: Maximum diff bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Set 0 for unlimited.

calculate_checksum.desc: Calculate MD5, SHA1, or SHA256 checksum of one or more files. Cross-platform — prefer this over md5sum/shasum/sha256sum via run_command.

params.paths: Array of file paths to checksum.

create_symlink.desc: Create a symbolic link. Cross-platform. On Windows, creating symlinks may require elevated privileges or Developer Mode to be enabled.

params.source: The path that the symlink points to (the target file or directory).
params.link: The path of the symlink to create.

compress_files.desc: Compress files or directories into an archive. Supports zip and tar.gz. Format is auto-detected from the output file extension. Each input is stored by its basename and subpaths — e.g. compressing /foo/bar/baz creates entries baz/... (not foo/bar/baz/...). Empty directories are skipped.

params.paths: Array of file/directory paths to include in the archive.
params.format: Archive format: "zip" or "tar.gz". Default: auto-detected from output extension.

extract_archive.desc: Extract a zip or tar.gz archive to a directory. Format is auto-detected from file extension. Path-traversal protected — entries that resolve outside the output directory are rejected.

params.archive: Path to the archive file (zip or tar.gz).
params.output: Directory to extract into. Default: current working directory.
params.format: Archive format: "zip" or "tar.gz". Default: auto-detected from archive extension.
